title: IFR Pilot Progression (4 Weeks)
description: A structured month-long path to build cockpit setup discipline, descent planning, EFB workflow, and practical TBM IFR systems handling.

lessons.title: Cold & Dark Foundations
lessons.objective: Set up your cockpit correctly and build reliable startup discipline.

lessons.title: Descent Planning Basics
lessons.objective: Learn 3:1 descent planning and speed/energy management before approach.

lessons.title: EFB Workflow and Flight Prep
lessons.objective: Use EFB tools for planning, performance setup, and better cockpit flow.

lessons.title: TBM Weather Radar + VNAV
lessons.objective: Apply IFR workflow in a fast turboprop with radar and TOD management.
